description: User review priority: exactly FIVE distinct digits per hand (four fingers plus opposable thumb), anatomically believable proportions and visible separation. Hair appearance intentionally deferred. Keep playable armored Bellwarden and existing offline gameplay.

tasks.goal: Refine the fused HumanAnatomy/ContinuousHuman hands toward physically believable palms, four separate fingers plus a thumb on each side. Require actual air gaps at fingertips, plausible digit-length order, knuckles and finger webbing without tearing off at the hand. No extra fingers and no mitten artifact. Keep HumanHandsTest and ContinuousHumanTest green.

Define finger base/knuckle/thumb opposition joint landmarks compatible with the 15-bone human base, and plan articulated 3-joint finger chains without changing playable legacy armor animation until verified.

Improve repeatable extreme hand camera for Android Model Atelier; capture real front, three-quarter, side closeups of both hands. Review screenshots for visible count and gaps, not code-only digit count.
Maintain nonmetal skin shading, subtle knuckle creases and believable nail colors only once finger geometry is proven. Avoid any hair/hairline updates.
Continue torso and facial anatomy refinement, but do not prioritize hair. Keep original neutral shorts and connected body topology.
